points.description: States that a function signature includes the name of the function (function name/identifier).
States that it includes the parameter list (the parameters the function takes).
States that the parameter list includes the types of the parameters (e.g. int, double), not just names or count.

rubric.notes: Full marks only if the answer precisely says the signature is the function name plus the parameter list with parameter types. Each element is separate; vague wording such as "the function's details" or "how it is declared" earns nothing. A wrong statement about an element (e.g. saying the signature includes the function body, or that the return type is required) means that point earns nothing.
